# Each session (one terminator test, or the sweep) opens three connections:
#   S1 = 1st (commands; free-form and direct replies), S2 = 2nd (INFO/ERR/WARN),
#   S3 = 3rd (position frames) -- firmware slots 0/1/2 if nothing else is connected.
